name: Statutory Parental Bereavement Pay & Leave
description: 2 weeks paid leave if a child under 18 dies or a baby is stillborn after 24 weeks of pregnancy.
eligibility_summary: Employees are entitled to 2 weeks of paid parental bereavement leave following the death of a child under 18 or a stillbirth after 24 weeks. Must be taken within 56 weeks of the death. Paid at the statutory flat rate.
